page.layout: Two columns side by side, each an alphabetical index in lines. Left column: letters I, L and M with their entries. Right column: continues M, then N and O. No page number, catchword or signature printed. Running head "INDEX" at the top, centred.

page.notes: Left column starts with a large woodcut-style initial "I" joined to the first word ("IAfonis"); read as "Iafonis" in the entry, with the capital I marking the letter heading. Several entries are blurred on the scan: "Inauditi,indicta caussa" (the word after "caussa" is read as "iniu" and is partly lost), and "Iudicis incopetentis" (the "p" may be "c"). "Nicena" line "termina uit" is printed with a space and is kept as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Greek "Νουθεσία" is copied as printed from the scan. Mid-page entries "Matrimonium" and "Matrimoniū" are both as printed. The large dropped letters for N and O are printed as letter headings in the right column.
